social_rules: Seed patents are absolute; unauthorized growth is a capital crime.
Rain is a debt; those who cannot pay the water tax are exiled to the dry-zones.
Umbrella duels are the only legal way to settle disputes outside of court.
The Rain Organist's melody is law; to interrupt a performance is heresy.

Entering the Hub as a desperate Petitioner.
Smuggling yourself in through the Gutter Dock.
conflict_hooks: The Heirloom Vine has been stolen, and the city's water supply is failing.
Arbiter Vane is planning to seize all private conservatories.
The Fungal Saboteurs have planted a bomb in the Singing Organ.

visual_style: The world is a mix of Victorian industrialism and lush, overgrown botany. Brass pipes, steam, and clockwork gears are everywhere, often covered in moss or vines. The lighting is filtered through thick glass panes, creating a perpetual 'greenhouse' atmosphere.

visual_canon.lighting: diffused sunlight through glass, flickering gas lanterns, glowing bioluminescent plants

terrain.edge: glass walls or deep drainage gutters

sprite_language.role_readability: distinctive hats and tools (e.g., barrister's wigs, mechanic's goggles)

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Citizens wear layered, waterproof clothing with brass accents. High-status individuals wear silk and lace, while workers wear leather and heavy canvas.
visual_consistency_rules: All characters must have at least one brass accessory.
All characters must wear waterproof footwear.
Status is indicated by the quality of the fabric and the shine of the brass.
